mechanic_exploited: Exploits livestock production cycles, Wheat feeding requirements (1 Wheat/animal/day to prevent animal escape), CARE yield banking on fed days, and town shop demand absorption. Cows produce Milk (base price $160) every 2 days and Sheep produce Wool (base price $200) every 3 days. Cow herd scaling dominates because 3 town shops consume 18 Milk/day (preventing price decay and sustaining sales above base $160 up to $266), whereas Wool gluts quickly due to only 1 town shop demanding 12 Wool/day. Geese (Egg base price $50) yield low revenue per action despite 2 town shops. Maximizing Cow ratio to Wheat feed costs delivers optimal income per action.
implementation_complexity: Moderate (~50-100 lines for pasture construction, wheat feed purchasing, daily feeding/care action loops, and milk sell order management)
expected_yield_gain: +4,450 to +15,000+ coins net gain over mixed-herd or unoptimized livestock strategies
